Dermatitis.description: Inflammation of the skin causing redness, itching, and discomfort. Can be caused by allergies, irritants, or infections.
Dermatitis.treatment_approach: Anti-inflammatory medication, medicated shampoos, identifying and removing the trigger cause.

Fungal_infections.description: Various fungal skin infections that can cause hair loss, scaling, and discomfort. May spread if untreated.
Fungal_infections.treatment_approach: Antifungal medication (topical and/or oral), medicated baths, environmental cleaning.

Healthy.description: No visible skin abnormalities detected. The skin appears normal and healthy.
Healthy.treatment_approach: Continue regular grooming, balanced diet, and routine veterinary check-ups.

Hypersensitivity.description: An allergic skin reaction caused by environmental allergens, food, or flea bites. Results in itching and discomfort.
Hypersensitivity.treatment_approach: Identify and avoid allergens, antihistamines, hypoallergenic diet, flea prevention.

demodicosis.description: A skin condition caused by Demodex mites that live in hair follicles. Can lead to hair loss and secondary infections.
demodicosis.treatment_approach: Acaricidal treatment (oral or topical), medicated dips, treating secondary infections.

ringworm.description: A contagious fungal infection that causes circular, hairless lesions. Highly transmissible to other animals and humans.
ringworm.treatment_approach: Antifungal medication (oral and topical), environmental disinfection, isolate from other pets.
